subject: Privileged-access origins and SCIM/SAML evidence batch — Novamed request
messages:
From: Elena Sokolova <elena.s@novamed.health>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: security@novamed.health
Date: 2027-05-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SCIM/SAML & RBAC evidence for SOC2 intake

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of our SOC 2 readiness review we need a small bundle of IAM artifacts to validate provisioning and least-privilege controls for the environment Redwood hosts for Novamed. Can you provide the following by end of day PT Friday (2027-06-02)?

Requested items (high level):
- SCIM delta for the tenant for the last 30 days (CSV preferred) — we need a sample of additions/deprovisions and attributes changed.
- SAML assertion samples (redacted) for three recent interactive admin logins (timestamped).
- RBAC role-to-owner mapping for service accounts and admin roles (owner email + justification).
- A short note describing automated provisioning flows (who can auto-provision, who can approve).
- Any redaction guidance or a redaction log if you need us to filter sensitive fields.

If you have a secure Drive drop or a transfer link, share it and we'll pull down the artifacts. If the timeline is tight, flag which items will take longer and we'll adjust.

Feel free to loop in engineering folks directly — I copied Novamed security for visibility.

Best,
Elena Sokolova
Senior Security Analyst
Novamed Health

-----Original Message-----
(Elena's note attached inline for context.)

Mateo — delivering artifacts for initial intake. See brief notes below and the secure drop link. I redacted usernames and phone numbers per our privacy guidance; redaction details are in redaction_log_20270529.txt.

Delivered files (secure drop): https://drive.redwood.com/secure/Novamed/IAM_Evidence_20270529
Attachments included:
- scim_delta_20270525.csv [attachment: scim_delta_20270525.csv (text/csv)] — includes timestamp, user id (hashed), operation (create/update/delete), and changed attributes. We hashed user emails and left org_id intact for mapping.
- role_owner_map_20270528.csv [attachment: role_owner_map_20270528.csv (text/csv)] — lists roles, role_id, primary_owner (redwood handle), owner_email (redacted to @redwood.com domain only), and short justification for role existence.
- saml_assertions_samples.xml [attachment: saml_assertions_samples.xml (application/xml)] — three assertions with assertion IDs and Issuer; Sensitive attributes removed (NameID hashed). Each assertion has a timestamp field in UTC.
- redaction_log_20270529.txt [attachment: redaction_log_20270529.txt (text/plain)] — column-level redaction notes and reason codes.

Notes:
- We excluded any full token strings or long-lived secret material.
- Service account owners that are shared across teams are marked with a steward column in the role_owner_map file.
- Provisioning flow doc (short narrative) is attached in the drive as provisioning_flow_20270529.md — Irene populated that section.

If Novamed wants additional sample assertions or un-hashed emails for matched account lookups, we should schedule a secure session to share via an encrypted transfer and an NDA amendment.

Laura Bennett
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
